name: bluechonk-plugins
description: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

description_i18n.zh-CN: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

plugins.name: deepseek-toolkit
plugins.description: DeepSeek 全家桶应用 API：联网搜索、网页抓取、OCR、语音识别、语音合成，零依赖 CLI 加配套 command、skill 与 MCP 服务。

description_i18n.en: DeepSeek application APIs: web search, page fetch, OCR, speech recognition and text to speech, as a zero-dependency CLI plus matching commands, skills and MCP servers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: DeepSeek 全家桶应用 API：联网搜索、网页抓取、OCR、语音识别、语音合成，零依赖 CLI，并配套 command、skill 与 MCP 服务。

plugins.name: todo-guard
plugins.description: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.

description_i18n.en: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 待办纪律核对：确保任务拆解与进度更新真的用上了 TodoWrite，且重写清单前先做过 TodoRead。只提示不阻断，不产生任何文件。

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using; the review can be toggled with /security-review-on and /security-review-off.

description_i18n.en: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using; the review can be toggled with /security-review-on and /security-review-off.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 编辑后即时做安全模式检查；每轮收尾时用 ZCode 当前在跑的模型审查本轮的 git diff，可用 /security-review-on 与 /security-review-off 开关。

plugins.name: run-trace
plugins.description: Keep long-running commands observable: trace runner writes a live log line by line while streaming to the terminal, and hooks flag commands whose output or exit code would be lost.

description_i18n.en: Keep long-running commands observable: trace runner writes a live log line by line while streaming to the terminal, and hooks flag commands whose output or exit code would be lost.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 让长跑命令始终可观测：trace 运行器边跑边落盘同时实时回显，hook 拦住输出或退出码会丢失的写法。

plugins.name: repo-guardian
plugins.description: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, LF and .gitattributes, credentials and build artifacts kept out of the repo, the pre-commit self-check, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.

description_i18n.en: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, LF and .gitattributes, credentials and build artifacts kept out of the repo, the pre-commit self-check, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 仓库健康检查与本机规则执行：CI 有无、LF 与 .gitattributes、凭据与构建产物不入库、提交前自查、禁用命令、emoji 与临时文件落点，以及写入后的代码与注释规范核对。

plugins.name: pua-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges PUA's Claude Code command hooks into ZCode: session flavor restore, frustration triggers, integrity guard, failure detection, loop state machine, subagent accounting and pre-compact checkpoints.

description_i18n.en: Bridges PUA's Claude Code command hooks into ZCode: session flavor restore, frustration triggers, integrity guard, failure detection, loop state machine, subagent accounting and pre-compact checkpoints.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 PUA 的 Claude Code 命令钩子接进 ZCode：会话风味恢复、不满触发、完整性守卫、失败检测、loop 状态机、子代理会计与压缩前检查点。

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then triage them into clean topic branches. Also enforces the dev-branch discipline with three hooks.

description_i18n.en: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then triage them into clean topic branches. Also enforces the dev-branch discipline with three hooks.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 探索式开发的收口流程：dev 分支上积累 wip 提交，定期拆成干净的主题分支；并用三个 hook 约束「草稿落 dev」。
